recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Spinach Chicken
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Squeeze excess water out of thawed spinach; in a large bowl, mix spinach with onion and cottage cheese and set aside.

Season chicken breasts with Cajun-style seasoning, then place 1/4 of cheese/spinach mixture in the center of each breast and fold in half. Secure with toothpicks and place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle with melted butter and bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for about 25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

raw_recipe.headline: Cottage Cheese Spinach Chicken
raw_recipe.description: Cajun-seasoned chicken breast stuffed with a cottage cheese and spinach mixture, then baked in butter. Serve with tossed salad, if desired.

review.reviewBody: We loved this recipe. I added a little extra cottage cheese and a little garlic. Instead of rolling the chicken, I just butterflied and filled them. It took much longer to cook than recipe stated. I ended up baking it at 400 degrees for about 50 minutes.

After reading the reviews and recommendations, I used a bag of fresh baby spinach, sauteed the onions in butter and added 1 tsp. minced garlic and blended all that with the cottage cheese plus 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese. I butterflied the chicken breasts and stuffed with as much of the cheese mixture as I could and used the toothpicks to keep together as recommended. Then I lightly salted and peppered both sides of the breasts and browned them on both sides in a cast iron skillet with a tablespoon of butter and a tablespoon of olive oil. Once golden brown on both sides, I baked in the oven for 30 minutes at 350 covered with foil. This was moist and very flavorful and I have since served to guests who loved it. I did not add cajun seasoning to the stuffing mixture.

I added 2 cloves of chopped garlic and sautéed with onion for 7 minutes before adding to cottage cheese, Used fresh steamed spinach. Added 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese and added to cottage cheese mixture. Flattened out chicken breasts before adding cheese mixture. Baked for 30 minutes. Super moist and delicious.

I absolutely adore this recipe. I did make some changes based on what others had commented. For example, I added some garlic with the in with the onion. Also I added about 1/3 cup of shredded Swiss cheese to the mixture. In addition I butterflied the chicken breasts and stuffed the mixture inside. Then I browned the chicken breast on both sides (no need for toothpicks; things pretty much stayed in place). Finally I covered my baking dish in tinfoil and baked it in the oven at 350 degrees for probably 45 - 50 minutes, removing the tinfoil for the last 10 minutes. Oh my goodness it was so scrumptious! I found it not lacking in flavor at all I used a premade Creole seasoning that had lots of spices and some salt in it and all the flavors blended so nicely. Thank you for a Great Recipe!

Came out delicious. I added extra spinach, 4 garlic cloves and 2 tablespoons cream cheese and wow so good. I also saved half the sauce and poured it over the chicken afterwards. Amazing, thanks for the recipe.

It was pretty good. My husband liked it, but I thought it was a little bland. I did make it with a Knorr Broccoli Rice dish, and when the rice, spinach mixture, and chicken was together, it had a much better flavor. I also cooked it covered so that the breasts wouldn't get dried out and just uncovered the last 5 minutes. 25 minutes was enough for the 2 lbs butterflied. I think a 9x9 pan would have been big enough.
I LOVE THIS RECIPE IVE ALREADY MADE IT 3 TIMES. I'm not a Cajun gal so I subbed equal parts paprika, oregano, black pepper, salt, garlic powder and onion powder.

We loved this Chicken Recipe. I did add fresh garlic and used fresh spinach instead of frozen. Also, I didn't roll the chicken. I simply made a "pouch" and added the stuffing mix. I took the advise of another and baked at 375 degrees for 40 minutes. It remained juicy! I will make over and over again. Thank you!

This recipe was okay but after reading Your comments that were spot on, this recipe needed something more added to the spinach - cottage cheese mixture. So I added three tablespoons of pesto sauce that I made real quick, and the flavors were amazing. Try this quick addition and hopefully you'll be as amazed as I was.

I followed some of the other reviews. Because I was pressed for time, I seasoned my breasts with cayenne and threw them on the Foreman grill for 3 mins per side. I sautéed my spinach and onion in a tiny bit of EVOO and added the 2tbsp butter at the end. Then I mixed in the cottage cheese, salt and pepper and just placed it on top of the chicken. I butterflied the breast but just end up making 2 pieces out of one. It was incredibly delicious!

I halved the breast, pounded it, and used Montreal Chicken Spice, because that's what I had. I added dry feta to the spinach mix and filled the center. I did not need toothpicks. Placed the breast in a greased 9x9 inch pan, and surrounded it with the extra stuffing mix. Turned out very juicy and flavourful! Good base for a variety of meals.
The only thing I added was garlic and some Dubliner cheese into the cottage cheese mixture. Just wow. I baked the breast at 375 for 40 minutes. Done to perfection and oh so tender❤️
Delicious. added garlic and sautéed with the onions and spinach.

I pounded a single chicken flat and used this recipe for my toddlers dinner, I also added a garlic onion season mix I’ve had in my cupboard to the cottage cheese and used fresh spinach. It was so yummy and my toddler liked it too
I had ricotta cheese in the fridge so I used that in place of cottage cheese. It was delicious!!!!

I love this recipe I literally had everything in the fridge. I added a little more cheese to the mixture because that's all I had. I think this recipe is delicious and I can't wait until payday so I can use some of the suggestions you guys made. I paired this with rice and string beans. Not anly is delicious but also budget friendly.

added some parm and bacon bits to up the protein, this will definitely be added to our meal rotation. Easy and delicious, my husband inhaled it and I made enough for him to take for lunch tomorrow. Happy campers for sure thank you!
We used chicken thighs and did not use the butter. It was delicious.
we used blackened seasoning and we enjoyed it very much. quite unexpected it was great
